```{r}
# Defining stretch function for imgs
stretch <- function(x, p = c(0.01, 0.99)) {
  q <- quantile(x[x > 0], p)                       # ignore the black border
  as.cimg(pmin(pmax((x - q[1]) / (q[2] - q[1]), 0), 1), dim = dim(x))
}
```

# What is ROP?

Retinopathy of prematurity is an eye disease affecting premature infants  
where abnormal blood vessels grow in the retina,  
potentially leading to retinal detachment and vision loss.  

# Normal

healthy; no findings; no lesion signs;  
no retinopathy; incomplete vascularization.  

```{r, echo=FALSE}
img <- load.image(imgs$path[imgs$label == "normal"][1])

green    <- G(img)                                  # red-free: green channel only
fluor    <- 1 - stretch(green)                      # vessels dark in green -> bright

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(img,   axes = FALSE, main = "Standard color")
plot(stretch(green), axes = FALSE, main = "Red-free (green channel)")
```

# Stage 1

a thin white line at the vascular-avascular junction  
with possible abnormal vessel branching.  

```{r, echo=FALSE}
img <- load.image(imgs$path[imgs$label == "Stage 1 ROP"][3])

green    <- G(img)                                  # red-free: green channel only
fluor    <- 1 - stretch(green)                      # vessels dark in green -> bright

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(img,   axes = FALSE, main = "Standard color")
plot(stretch(green), axes = FALSE, main = "Red-free (green channel)")
```

# Stage 2

ridge with width and height that evolves from the demarcation line;  
the ridge may vary in height; the ridge's color ranges from white to pink;  
small isolated tufts of neovascular tissue lying on the surface of the retina;  
ridge is raised and thicker than stage 1 ROP.  

```{r, echo=FALSE}
img <- load.image(imgs$path[imgs$label == "Stage 2 ROP"][5])

green    <- G(img)                                  # red-free: green channel only
fluor    <- 1 - stretch(green)                      # vessels dark in green -> bright

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(img,   axes = FALSE, main = "Standard color")
plot(stretch(green), axes = FALSE, main = "Red-free (green channel)")
```

# Stage 3

extraretinal neovascular proliferation extends from the ridge into the vitreous;  
is continuous with the posterior aspect of the ridge, causing a ragged appearance as  
proliferation becomes more extensive; Seemingly flat-appearing extraretinal neovascularization  
can occur in eyes with zone 1 or posterior zone 2 disease,in the absence  
of an obvious ridge or demarcation line.  

```{r, echo=FALSE}
img <- load.image(imgs$path[imgs$label == "Stage 3 ROP"][4])

green    <- G(img)                                  # red-free: green channel only
fluor    <- 1 - stretch(green)                      # vessels dark in green -> bright

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(img,   axes = FALSE, main = "Standard color")
plot(stretch(green), axes = FALSE, main = "Red-free (green channel)")
```

# Stage 4

partial retinal detachment, either spares  or involves the fovea;  
traction on extraretinal neovascularization leads to retinal elevation;  
tractional retinal detachment in the area of the peripheral ridge;  
detachment involving the macula; detachment with associated subretinal  
hemorrhage and lipid exudation into the macula; detachment of  
vascularized retina into a volcano shaped configuration.  

```{r, echo=FALSE}
img <- load.image(imgs$path[imgs$label == "Stage 4 ROP"][5])

green    <- G(img)                                  # red-free: green channel only
fluor    <- 1 - stretch(green)                      # vessels dark in green -> bright

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(img,   axes = FALSE, main = "Standard color")
plot(stretch(green), axes = FALSE, main = "Red-free (green channel)")
```

# Stage 5

total retinal detachment; open-funnel detachment, the optic disc is visible by ophthalmoscopy;  
closed-funnel detachment, the optic disc is not visible secondary;  
the optic disc is not visible secondary to retrolental fibrovascular tissue.  

```{r, echo=FALSE}
img <- load.image(imgs$path[imgs$label == "Stage 5 ROP"][3])

green    <- G(img)                                  # red-free: green channel only
fluor    <- 1 - stretch(green)                      # vessels dark in green -> bright

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(img,   axes = FALSE, main = "Standard color")
plot(stretch(green), axes = FALSE, main = "Red-free (green channel)")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
show_bright <- function(path, thr = 0.05, k = 2) {
  img  <- resize(load.image(path))
  g    <- G(img)
  mask <- grayscale(img) > thr
  gm   <- g[mask]
  cut  <- mean(gm) + k * sd(gm)      # same rule as bright_prop
  bright <- mask & (g > cut)

  out <- img                          # copy; original is unchanged
  R(out)[bright] <- 1
  G(out)[bright] <- 0
  B(out)[bright] <- 0

  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0))
  plot(img, axes = FALSE, main = "Original")
  plot(out, axes = FALSE,
       main = sprintf("Bright pixels: %.2f%%", 100 * mean(gm > cut)))
  invisible(out)
}
```

```{r}
for (i in c(0,1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2)){
  show_bright(imgs$path[imgs$label == "Stage 5 ROP"][3], k=i)
}#1.5, 0, 1.75, 0, 1.5
```

```{r}
LINE_G   <- 0.80
VESSEL_G <- 0.25
G_TOL    <- 0.1

show_stretch_match <- function(path, line_val = LINE_G, vessel_val = VESSEL_G,
                               tol = G_TOL, thr = 0.05) {
  img    <- resize(load.image(path))
  retina <- as.array(grayscale(img) > thr)[, , 1, 1]
  gs <- as.array(stretch(G(img)))[, , 1, 1]   # stretched green, 0-1

  line_hit   <- retina & (abs(gs - line_val)   < tol)
  vessel_hit <- retina & (abs(gs - vessel_val) < tol)

  arr <- array(gs, dim = c(dim(gs), 1, 3))   # grayscale base in all 3 channels

  arr[, , 1, 1][line_hit]   <- 1; arr[, , 1, 2][line_hit]   <- 0; arr[, , 1, 3][line_hit]   <- 0  # red
  arr[, , 1, 1][vessel_hit] <- 0; arr[, , 1, 2][vessel_hit] <- 1; arr[, , 1, 3][vessel_hit] <- 1  # cyan

  out <- as.cimg(arr)

  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0))
  plot(img, axes = FALSE, main = "Original")
  plot(out, axes = FALSE, rescale = FALSE,
       main = sprintf("Line (red): %.2f%% | Vessel (cyan): %.2f%%",
                      100 * mean(line_hit[retina]),
                      100 * mean(vessel_hit[retina])))
  invisible(out)
}
```

```{r}
show_stretch_match(imgs$path[imgs$label == "normal"][1])
show_stretch_match(imgs$path[imgs$label == "normal"][2])
show_stretch_match(imgs$path[imgs$label == "normal"][3])
show_stretch_match(imgs$path[imgs$label == "normal"][4])
```
